_instructions: One entry per CoE section: a SharePoint page (from its .md file), a standard Teams channel with a 'Start here' tab, a left-navigation link, kit sample files under Files\<channel>, and optional organization files from <OrgPath>\Assets\<category> (the installer asks before hosting them; they replace kit samples in the same folder). Tokens such as {{OrgName}} are filled from the organization's Deployment-Settings.json. Featured agents are approved, non-retired rows with AgentFeatured=true in the Copilot Agent Showcase list. Both agent views are always embedded and update from the list. Agents in Deployment-Settings.json seed new proposals only.

successStories.Title: SAMPLE - Plain-language rewrite of a public notice
successStories.Task: A program specialist asks Copilot Chat to rewrite a published service-change notice in plain language, then checks every date and requirement against the original.

successStories.Title: SAMPLE - Meeting notes to an action list
successStories.Task: A supervisor turns their own non-sensitive meeting notes into decisions and next steps with owners, then confirms owners and dates with the team.

successStories.Title: SAMPLE - Briefing from public reports
successStories.Task: A program manager drafts a one-page briefing from two published reports and has a subject matter expert verify each figure before it goes to leadership.

successStories.Title: SAMPLE - Drafting a service desk knowledge article
successStories.Task: A service desk analyst drafts a how-to article from public Microsoft documentation and has a colleague review it before publishing.
